Name: Green Cheek Conure Parrot Kids
Author: gyftin
Description:
I just made another reskin, this time of a Yellowside GCC

Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33928290]Ankokou[/url] (original creator).

Link to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/309]The Original Lovebird Mod[/url] by Ankokou
Link to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4240]The Modified Senegal Mod[/url] by DaisyNiko


[u]note[/u]: you might also want to download clockworkhound's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3540]ChildBedConfig[/url] to remove the kids' beds (not the crib, though) from your farmhouse/cabins

[u]NEW: ADD [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12602?tab=description]THIS [/url]﻿TO REMOVE THAT WEIRD BLACK BAR BEHIND THE PARROT CAGE!
^^ Optional but satisfying



INSTALLATION[/u]

1. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. download this mod and open the .zip folder
3. extract "[CP] GCC Parrot Kids" to [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
4. run the game using SMAPI
